Title: Kunal's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Kunal - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Shalini - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Sanjay - 46 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Kavya - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress
5. Rohan - 8 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Shalini, Sanjay and Kavya stand near him.]

Shalini: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal writes in his notebook.]

Kunal: "Careful!"

[Kunal's phone rings and he answers it.]

Shalini (laughing): "One more time!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Shalini, Sanjay and Kavya stand near him.]

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[Kunal dances to the music.]

Shalini: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal claps his hands.]

Kavya (gently): "That's great!"

[Kunal hugs Mother tightly.]

Kunal (gently): "Mom, listen!"

[Kunal waves goodbye to Mother.]

Kunal (softly): "Dad, look at this."

[Kunal points at the sky.]

Shalini: "That's great!"

[Kunal thinks for a moment.]

Kunal: "One more time!"

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Kunal is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Shalini, Sanjay and Rohan stand near him.]

Kunal: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Kunal (excited): "What a day to remember!"
